name: measurements
title: Measurements
description: Quantified or coded facts. A measurement may hang off a deployment (sensor), a media file (image-derived), an observation (evidence for a claim), or any combination. A measurement MUST reference at least one of deploymentID, observationID, or mediaID. measurementValue is a string (Darwin Core MeasurementOrFact). Consumers MUST interpret datatype and semantics from measurementType, measurementUnit, and measurementScheme.

fields.name: deploymentID
fields.description: Deployment or visit this measurement belongs to. Use this for in-situ sensors that are not derived from a photograph. Foreign key to `deployments.deploymentID`.

fields.name: observationID
fields.description: Observation this measurement supports, if any. Foreign key to `observations.observationID`.

fields.name: mediaID
fields.description: Media file this measurement was taken from or computed on, if any. Foreign key to `media.mediaID`.

fields.name: measurementType
fields.description: What was measured. Prefer a term from `schemas/core/vocabularies/measurement-types.json`. Profiles may add terms.

fields.name: measurementValue
fields.description: Lexical value. Consumers MUST interpret datatype from `measurementType`, `measurementUnit`, and `measurementScheme`. `42`, `42.0`, and `forest` are all strings here. This follows Darwin Core MeasurementOrFact.

fields.name: measurementUnit
fields.description: Unit of `measurementValue`. Use UCUM-like symbols where possible (`degC`, `m`, `ug/m3`, `mag/arcsec2`, `%`). Empty for dimensionless codes.

fields.name: measurementScheme
fields.description: Authority or classification system for coded values (e.g. `corine`, `nlcd`, `esa-worldcover`, `bortle`, `openaq-aqi`).

fields.name: datasetID
fields.description: External dataset or instrument identifier when `measurementSource` is `externalDataset` or `modelOutput`.

fields.name: datasetVersion
fields.description: Version, product, or processing level of `datasetID`.

fields.name: measurementAccuracy
fields.description: Reported accuracy or uncertainty, in the same unit as `measurementUnit` when numeric.

fields.name: measurementMethod
fields.description: Method or protocol used to obtain the value.

fields.name: measurementDeterminedBy
fields.description: Person, sensor, station, or model that produced the value.

fields.name: measurementDeterminedDate
fields.description: Date and time the value was determined. ISO 8601 with timezone designator.

fields.name: classificationProbability
fields.description: Model confidence when the value is image-derived or a model output, `0`–`1`.

fields.name: measurementRemarks
fields.description: Comments or notes about the measurement.
